Title: Monster Train Accessibility
Description: Full accessibility mod for totally blind players. Provides screen reader support via NVDA, JAWS, or Windows Narrator, and complete keyboard navigation for all game elements including menus, battles, card drafts, and map navigation.
ChangeLog: 8.6.0: battle floors on the arrows (Up climbs from the hand to the bottom, middle and top floors and the pyre room, selecting the floor in the game; Left/Right walk its units and the pyre; Up/Down also pick the floor when playing a card; Shift+K removed). 8.5.0: focus cleanup (info-only stops skipped, no game-driven focus chatter in battle, no false floor targeting for unit spells), trial switch labelled, settings tabs and pause menu named, logbook tabs labelled, logbook upgrade spam removed. 8.4.0: Spanish added to the game's own language list, translation completed, mod speech follows the game language. 8.3.0: Spanish (see jugar_en_español.txt). 8.2.0: boss intent changes, artifact trigger effects, merchant, skip gold, text cleanups. 8.1.1: Relentless and boss action descriptions fixed. 8.1.0: scene descriptions rewritten from the game art and intro video. 8.0.0: mod keys moved off game keys (F2-F7, F9 settings, J, K, L, G), live combat narration with many new events, scene descriptions, map, reward, run history and run summary readers. See release-notes/v8.0.0.md
